text:
Ava (mktg): Heads up — planning a multivariate paid push (search + retarget) to drive signups for the May 6 webinar. Want to run a 72‑hour burst around registration opens. Draft of what I'm thinking below, need budget + creative sign-off by EOD. :rocket:

Liam (growth): numbers? daily and total?

Ava (mktg): Daily cap $1,200, 72h = $3,600. Initial hourly ramp for first 6 hours: 30% of daily to create momentum, then standard pacing. Goal CPL <$60, target CPA 50 signups.

Priya (creative): Can we test two hero images + 3 headline variants? Recommend creative set B (concise CTAs) for retarget.

Sam (analytics): Landing page variants? We should send traffic 60/40 to LP-A (webinar page w/ testimonial) and LP-B (short form + agenda). Also flag UTMs.

Dani (ops): Lead routing — confirm: top-of-funnel leads => SFDC campaign "May6-Webinar-PTF"; hot leads (attended + watched 40%) => email SDR queue via HubSpot workflow. Need Zap credentials by tomorrow.

Ava (mktg): Yep routing plan confirmed. Proposed UTM template: utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=may6_webinar&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={creative_variant}

Liam (growth): Can you paste the headline/copy variants? small + punchy works for search.

Priya (creative): Copy options:
```
H1-A: Build LLM features faster — join our May 6 webinar
H1-B: Ship production-ready LLM inference — free webinar
H1-C: Cut inference cost & latency — live demo May 6
Desc-A: Live demo + Q&A. Get our checklist for production LLM serving. Register now.
Desc-B: Practical guide to inference at scale. Seats limited — save yours.
```

Priya (creative): Retarget creative (short): "Missed the first wave? Get the practical LLM playbook — May 6" with CTA "Reserve Spot".

Sam (analytics): For tracking, add hidden field session_id and campaign_id on the LP so we can join ad clicks -> registration -> attendance. I'll add conversion tag.

Dani (ops): Campaign structure (GAds):
- Search: 3 ad groups (inference, low-latency, cost-optimization)
- Retarget: 7-day list + 30-day engaged viewers (UTM retarget tag)
- Bidding: Max conversions with target CPA $50, bid cap $12

Liam (growth): For pacing, set ad schedule to high bid multipliers 9am-12pm local for key regions, keep ROAS monitoring live. Also enable accelerated delivery for first 6 hours.

Ava (mktg): One more ask — can we swap creative if CTR < 0.6% after 6 hours? Auto-switch to variant C. 

Priya (creative): A/B test matrix noted. I'll upload assets to shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/mktg/may6-assets (placeholder).

Sam (analytics): I'll set GA4 event for webinar_reg and webinar_attend. Putting a short watch rule: attended = watched 40% OR event "attendance_confirmed".

ad-manager-bot: Campaign draft created: campaign_id=cmp_987654, draft_url=https://ads.redwood.internal/cmp_987654

Dani (ops): QA checklist before go-live: creative alt text, final UTM, LP form validation, Zap test to HubSpot, conversion tag firing.

Ava (mktg): Timeline: creatives in by 5pm today, campaigns created in draft by 7pm, QA and final go-live tomorrow 10am. Who owns creative upload? @Priya

Priya (creative): Got it, uploading now.

Liam (growth): I'll monitor first-hour metrics and post a short update here. :eyes:

Sam (analytics): If we see CPA drifting >20% after 12 hours, switch targeting to narrower intent keywords and increase retarget bid by 15%.

Dani (ops): Confirmed Zap flow test passed in staging. Need prod keys after final sign-off.

Ava (mktg): Thanks team. Last item — webinar landing page variant names: LP-A = testimonial-led, LP-B = agenda-led. We'll default 60/40 to A/B as Sam suggested.

Liam (growth): thumbs up. Sending calendar reminder to monitoring rota. :thumbsup:

Ava (mktg): Done — thanks everyone. Posting a quick runbook in the wiki after launch.

Priya (creative): small nudge — please approve headline H1-B for search if no objections by 4:45pm.

Sam (analytics): Approved.

Dani (ops): Approved.

ad-manager-bot: Campaign cmp_987654 moved from draft -> pending_review by Dani

Ava (mktg): End of thread — will update with final live timestamp once green.
